UniversalDeterministicAutomaton<S,I,T,SP,TP>
public static interface UniversalDeterministicAutomaton.RegularAutomaton<S,I,T,SP,TP> extends UniversalDeterministicAutomaton<S,I,T,SP,TP>, DeterministicAutomaton.RegularAutomaton<S,I,T>, UniversalAutomaton.RegularAutomaton<S,I,T,SP,TP>
Convenience interface that describes an automaton with finite syntactic and finite semantic state space. This type links a UniversalDeterministicAutomaton with DeterministicFiniteSemantics.
